To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed MPT hardware sampler can achieve a 31X speed-up over the PT hardware sampler for chain number 2.
the proposed MPT algorithm is able to achieve higher sampling throughput than PT for a given chain number, while maintaining similar mixing properties.

the proposed MPT algorithm is a better alternative for high-dimensional and/or multi-modal distributions compared with the existing PT sampler, and the proposed MPT hardware accelerator is scalable, pipelined, and has higher throughput as compared with the existing state-of-the-art PT hardware accelerators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a high-throughput hardware accelerator for the MCMC algorithms, and the proposed MPT is the first of its kind in this regard.
the design and implementation of a high-throughput MCMC accelerator for stochastic processing techniques.
the design of a scalable and pipelining hardware accelerator for the MPT sampler, which can be used for real-time stochastic processing applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MPT sampler achieves higher throughput compared to PT sampler for all the tested chain numbers.
the proposed MPT algorithm is a scalable and efficient algorithm to generate high throughput MCMCs samples.
the proposed MPT MCMC sampler can achieve 28x higher throughput as compared to a state-of-the-art PT MCMC sampler.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed and implemented a fully scalable, pipelined, and high-throughput MCMC accelerator on FPGA.
the throughput of a MPT sampler is 31x, which is the highest reported throughput for MCMC sampler to date.
we have proposed and implemented a scalable hardware accelerator that can achieve higher throughput for high-dimensional and multimodal distributions compared to the state of the art.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed MPT MCMC sampler can be used to generate samples at a much faster rate than PT sampler with a similar number of chains.
the proposed MPT algorithm and its hardware implementation is a scalable solution to the throughput limitation of PT samplers.
MCMC samplars can be efficiently implemented on FPGA to achieve high throughput and can be easily extended to support more number of chains.
